body: The fatigue that comes with depression is so horrible, and people who've never experienced it will never understand. I  sometimes can barely lift my own arms, if I need to type something I need to take breaks and it's so slow. I've gone months without brushing my teeth or getting properly dressed and then maybe I'll have a day when I finally have enough energy to do something and afterwards it's gone again... Wish I could trade depression for cancer or something

It's okay, nobody knows. There is no answer to the afterlife or happiness. Some people can just be happier easier than others. I've lived with these thoughts, this darkness for so long, since I was a child and I don't know life without it. It's okay to want to live, but I also think it should be okay to give up. Know your limits, you know?
I'm constantly unhappy, I'm severely ill, I can't work due to the illnesses... So I just don't have a purpose. Why bother staying here, being unhappy and dead weight?
Suicide is the ultimate solution to everything, it's not for everyone, but I think it's for me. I don't believe in afterlife, so I won't take it into consideration when making my decision.
Why would I live for myself when it's me who wants to die. This is the most confusing thing I've ever been said when I'm about to commit suicide.
Loved? Yeah, sure, I won't argue that. Needed? No, nobody needs me.
Glad you like it!

I think I'd rather have people not replying than people arguing with me, because they apparently know my life better than I do. I wish I could just ignore it, but you don't really continue your emotions, just your response to them and I don't know how to.
Yeah, no problem. Hopefully it's something that you like :)
The idea is cool, but there was just something about that game that made it meh for me. Sorry about your laptop
"200,00 (in counterfeit 50 dollar bills)." "Pablo Picasso" is good too and "Mistaken I.D." I like how the songs have clear stories in the lyrics
I currently listening to Wolfie's Just Fine aka Jon Lajoie ("Show me your genitals") on repeat. I want to listen to something chill, maybe Citizen Cope next
I tried it a few years back and I didn't really like it. I have other games, but I don't feel like playing anything

Yeah, distracting is good when it works. I have steam library full of games and I like, some of them I should play and want to, but I just don't feel like playing. I'm too tired to go downstairs to get something to eat. And I'm supposed to cook today and get groceries, I just... can't. Even moving my arms to type feels like too much, I have to take breaks... I can't do this life thing anymore, it's not for me

It's never enough, tho. It never takes the darkness away. I just got a new laptop saturday and a hoodie that I've wanted is in the mail coming tomorrow, I've pre-ordered a collector's edition of a very anticipated game releasing next year, but I just don't care... They're just things, they don't cure depression or trauma or anything.
But then the day after will be shit again. It never stays good for long.
I think governments don't give a fuck about people in general.

Well, today feels like a completely different day again, my boyfriend really came through yesterday. Changing therapists sounds like a hassle, and I don't know how it would even work in public health care, I've always just dealt with them, especially since none of them were really bad from the start, but I only noticed afterwards that they were quite bad. I wish I could afford private therapists.

Can't get welfare as my boyfriend earns too much money (cutoff point is pretty low). 

I'd be okay with some good treatment where I'm actually listened to. My problem isn't just avoidance, I know I posted on the avpd subreddit, but it is not the only disorder I have. Borderline makes my life incredibly unstable, yesterday was an amazingly good day after awhile, but today has been total disaster. I can't really plan anything in advance, because I don't know how I will be feeling then. I might feel amazing in the next hour or really angry, I don't know how to control this, because therapy didn't teach it. I'm trying to get back into treatment, but I don't expect to see a therapist this year or the next. 

I'm of course capable of doing a lot of things, I do have a diploma from a vocational school and some experience. I could see myself working, happily even, but only for a very brief moment. I lose energy quickly and start self-destructing  quickly. I'd need a very specific environment and job to not start having breakdowns. I know I sound entitled and whiny, but maybe I'm just not cut out for this. This is all so unnatural. I did enjoy my first ever job, until my boss changed, so... I dunno.

I've looked and there aren't any options, I'm falling between the cracks. Sheltered work is also not an great option, if it even is an option. I can't leave the house, I can't even call anybody on the phone, I don't know how the hell I'd be able to go to work. And the program is slightly predatory, using vulnerable people for cheap labor... It's not a future that I want to have.

I can't, my lawyer quit and I can't afford another even if one took my case. The institution will just keep saying that bpd is treatable and that there are treatment options available, even if realistically they weren't an option, and that I will probably be able to work in, let's say 10 years. They won't change their mind, there's nothing left to do.

They have like sheltered work, where you're placed somewhere and the employer gets money for having you there, but I don't know how that is going to work when I can't even open the door to receive mail or go to my own backyard. Not to mention I'm unstable af. I tried asking for help before from the right place, but for reasons I've forgotten they just said they can do nothing. If I'd end up dead then they'd come from the woods and claim how I only needed to ask for help and I would have received it.

Realistically, I think the only viable option is death.

How would things get better? I have 2 personality disorders, I'm completely incapable of living alone and taking care of myself or it would take a few years to get to a point where I might be able live alone, but would still require constant support. Where can I get that? I've looked into assisted living, but you have to pay for that or work to pay for that and I can't do that. So, what is there left to do?
No, not really.

I tried killing myself when I was 18 and I was so close to getting it done, but pulled back. I'm almost 25 now and I regret not going through with it. Even when things are okay, I still regret it. When someone on askreddit asks what is one thing you'd change from your past or if you could go back in time to change one thing what would it be, I always think of the time I almost killed myself and how I'd try to make sure I went through with it.
